given: a stock row whose inventory_code has no batch or serial segment, such as "X-1" or a bare "c"
when: the migration backfills the new columns
then: batch_number and serial_number are left NULL for that row rather than guessed or dropped

independence.rationale: AC2 covers a conforming code producing values; this adds the distinct outcome that a nonconforming code produces NULLs instead of invented values

architectural_notes: Infra layer: the null-safe branch of the migration backfill transform. A code lacking a batch or serial segment leaves batch_number and serial_number NULL rather than guessing or dropping, so the columns are declared nullable and the parse step guards segment count. Owner module: the Alembic migration data step. Data-integrity concern: no silent loss / no invented values (R1). Verified by a real-branch test seeding a nonconforming code and asserting both columns are NULL and the row survives.
